svg.title: Animated side view and three-quarter view of a parallel-fold pop-up step: the card shuts, and the step made from a strip of the card folds down flat between the pages, then the card opens again to a right angle and the step stands back up, its top always parallel to the base page and its front always parallel to the back page.

g.text: step: one strip of the card,
Every crease is parallel to the centre fold, so the step stands up as the card opens
